description: A utility class for managing ThreadLocal context in the Fineract application, providing methods for context initialization, retrieval, and cleanup.

classes.name: ThreadLocalContextUtil
classes.description: A final utility class for managing thread-local context data such as tenant, auth token, business dates, and action context.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the current tenant from thread-local storage.

methods.name: setTenant
methods.description: Sets the tenant in thread-local storage.

methods.name: clearTenant
methods.description: Removes the tenant from thread-local storage.

methods.name: getDataSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current data source context string.

methods.name: setDataSourceContext
methods.description: Sets the data source context string.

methods.name: clearDataSourceContext
methods.description: Removes the data source context from thread-local storage.

methods.name: getBusinessDates
methods.description: Returns the map of business dates, asserting it is not null.

methods.name: setBusinessDates
methods.description: Sets the map of business dates, asserting it is not null.

methods.name: getBusinessDateByType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific business date by its type, asserting it is initialized.

methods.name: getBusinessDate
methods.description: Returns the current business date based on the action context's business date type.

methods.name: getActionContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current action context, defaulting if null.

methods.name: setActionContext
methods.description: Sets the action context, asserting it is not null.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Constructs and returns a FineractContext object with current thread-local data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes thread-local context from a given FineractContext object.
